text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Thursday.
- Is Croatia to join the Council of Europe soon?
- Zagreb - the pickpockets' favourite European captial.
- UNTAES no different from UNPROFOR, claim the refugees who are planning to hold a protest rally on Friday in Osijek.
- Who is the real owner of the Gavrilovic meat producing company?
- First body unearthed from the Ovcara mass grave.
- The government bill to be forwarded to the parliament: General amnesty as part of normalisation efforts.
- Zagreb is cooperating, while at the same time Belgrade is rejecting all cooperation, says in an interview, Antonio Cassese, the president of the International War Crimes Tribunal in the Hague.
- We shall save and revive the islands, claims in an interview the development and reconstruction minister, Jure Radic. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
